_doc: Lyria prompts for the procedural sounds (tools/sfx/generate.py). kind: shot = separate takes cut apart, loop = one steady recording looped. Ids are public/sounds/manifest.json ids; files keep their names.

strider_step.sound: the footfall of a 40 metre tall monster on a city street: a huge sub-bass boom, the ground thumping, debris and windows rattling, a long rolling rumble
strider_step.studio: giant footstep, huge monster stomp, heavy earth-shaking boom

strider_roar.sound: a colossal monster roaring over a city like a giant kaiju: a deep bellow sliding up into a rasping, screeching upper tone, then a guttural fall, echoing off tall buildings
strider_roar.studio: kaiju roar, giant monster roar, Godzilla style roar
